instruction: Choose exactly one allowed action. latestAttribution.cause: Explicitly filling the berserker's empty leg slot with the rare agility item raised visible equipped power by 50.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Challenge Main 10 with the fully prepared damage core and revise only if the complete enemy team defeats it.

latestAttribution.cause: The newly armed berserker led the complete-team fight with 39.78% damage and visible finishing attacks, preserving the damage core's clear despite the mage dying first.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Use any clearly damage-oriented new gear before Main 10, then test the same roster; revise only if the boss converts the mage's fragility into a loss.

latestAttribution.cause: The prepared four-output roster cleared Main 10 in 12.72 seconds with all four allies alive, validating continued use of the existing damage core for the unlocked boss.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Equip any direct physical-power drops on the ranger's empty slots, then challenge the unlocked boss with the full damage roster.

latestAttribution.cause: Explicitly equipping the physical-power and armor-breaking epic gloves on the berserker raised visible equipped power by 124.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Fill the berserker's empty leg slot with the positive-fit rare legs, then challenge Main 10.

latestAttribution.cause: Explicitly equipping the low-health and critical-damage weapon on the berserker raised visible equipped power by 74.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Challenge the complete four-enemy team with the strengthened verified roster before experimenting with the untested assassin.

latestAttribution.cause: Clearing the visible prison rescue unlocked the ranger advertised for sustained single-target damage.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Replace the consistently rank-four spear militia with the ranger and verify that the ranger exceeds the spear's recent 7.29% damage share on a Main 7 retry.

rosterChangeExpectations.rule: failure belongs to the observed team and encounter; each different swap is re-estimated from current character strength and context-relevant traits

hypotheses.problem: The team must keep enough damage while advancing into a new encounter.
hypotheses.cause: The full warrior's observed rank-one direct damage is the team's main clearing engine.

hypotheses.problem: The team contains a repeatedly weak damage contributor before the next main encounter.
hypotheses.cause: The barricade militia contributes little direct damage while the full mage is presented as an output specialist.

hypotheses.problem: The active team still contains a very low-damage healing slot before an encounter with enemy healing.
hypotheses.cause: A high-risk full output hero should add more direct pressure than the low-output herb militia.

hypotheses.problem: The first Main 7 attempt left the high-health enemy at 5% after the team died.
hypotheses.cause: The rank-four spear militia contributes too little sustained single-target damage compared with the rescued ranger's visible specialty.
